basis: PLAN section 10: the change is scalar translation/registry + capability keys, not query-path/cache/executor/materialization implementation; translation happens at prepare time and no new per-execution or per-row work is introduced.

diff_scan.scan_command: git diff aa31113b b5f8b360 -- src | rg '_dontCache|QueryCache|QueryCommand|SqlBuilder|QueryPlanner|RowMapper|RowMaterializer|GetPreparedQueryCommand|BenchmarkDotNet'

design_notes.registry: the key maps are static readonly Dictionary instances built once; translation performs a dictionary lookup only (no per-call allocation, no reflection, no type checks in the executor)
design_notes.render: SessionInfoFunctions.Supports/Render are the pre-existing per-dialect renderers; only switch arms were added
design_notes.no_sticky_command_mutation: no change touches the shared QueryCommand, the plan cache or the _dontCache flag

reopen_trigger: if a later diff adds execution/row/cache-path work to this feature, this exemption is void and PLAN must add baseline/BenchmarkDotNet measurement
